annotations.title: Change a bake in my Loafy journal

description: Change a bake in the baker's Loafy bake journal, by its id from list_my_bakes or log_bake: only the figures and notes given change, the rest stays, and a text given replaces the old text. No bake is deleted. Returns the bake with a link. Needs the baker's Loafy account.

autolyse_minutes.description: Minutes the flour and water rested before mixing, with the starter in for a fermentolyse.

bake_level.description: On a stove: the dial's level while baking.

bake_minutes.description: Minutes in the oven, whole minutes (90 seconds is 2); with two phases, the first.

bake_temp_celsius.description: Oven temperature in °C; with two phases, the first (in a Dutch oven, with the lid on). A value above 300 °C is only plausible in a pizza or wood-fired oven.

baked_on.description: The day of the bake, as YYYY-MM-DD.

baking_method.description: What it was baked in: home_oven also for a Dutch oven, a stone or a tray in it.

bulk_temp_celsius.description: Dough or room temperature during bulk, in °C.

dough_rise_percent.description: How much the dough grew during bulk fermentation, in percent.

dry_yeast_percent.description: Dry or instant yeast as a percentage of flour.

flours.description: The flours, comma-separated, each as its kind and grams, such as "bread_flour 450, rye 50", or its kind alone when no grams were given; kinds: bread_flour, all_purpose, whole_wheat, rye, spelt, einkorn, durum, tipo_00, other.

fresh_yeast_percent.description: Fresh yeast as a percentage of flour.

fridge_proof_hours.description: Hours the shaped dough proofed in the fridge.

hydration_percent.description: Water as a percentage of flour.

id.description: The bake's id, from list_my_bakes or log_bake.

loaf_shape.description: How a sourdough bread was shaped: boule (round) or batard (oval). A baguette or a loaf pan bread is a bake_type of its own.

next_time_notes.description: What to try differently next time.

notes.description: How the bake went, in the baker's words: only what no other parameter takes.

other_bake_type_description.description: What was baked, in the baker's words, when bake_type is other.

piece_weight_grams.description: What one piece weighed when it was divided, in grams.

pieces.description: How many pieces the dough was divided into: loaves, rolls or pizza balls.

pre_rest.description: That rest: an autolyse, flour and water only, or a fermentolyse, with the starter in.

preheat_level.description: On a stove: the dial's level while the pan heated.

preheat_temp_celsius.description: How hot the oven was preheated, in °C. A value above 300 °C is only plausible in a pizza or wood-fired oven.

problems.description: What went wrong, comma-separated, from: dense_crumb, gummy_interior, no_oven_spring, flat_loaf, burnt_crust, pale_crust, bland_flavor, too_sour, didnt_rise, sticky_dough; anything else goes in the notes.

proof_rise_percent.description: How much more the shaped dough grew during the proof, in percent.

rating.description: How it turned out, 1 to 5 stars.

room_temp_proof_hours.description: Hours the shaped dough proofed at room temperature.

salt_percent.description: Salt as a percentage of flour.

second_bake_minutes.description: Minutes of that second phase, whole minutes.

second_bake_temp_celsius.description: Oven temperature in °C of a second phase: with the lid off, or turned down. A value above 300 °C is only plausible in a pizza or wood-fired oven.

starter.description: The name of the baker's starter that went in, if any.

starter_percent.description: Starter as a percentage of flour.

stretch_fold_count.description: Sets of stretch and folds during bulk.

name: update_bake

outputSchema.description: The bake as saved in the journal.

bake.description: A bake in the baker's journal.

bake_minutes.description: Minutes in the oven; with two phases, the first.

bake_temp_celsius.description: Oven temperature, °C; with two phases, the first.

dough_rise_percent.description: How much the dough grew in bulk, %.

fermentolyse.description: The rest was a fermentolyse, with the starter in.

hydration_percent.description: Water as a share of the flour.

id.description: The bake's id, which update_bake takes.

other_bake_type_description.description: What was baked, when bake_type is other.

piece_weight_grams.description: What one piece weighed, in grams.

pieces.description: How many pieces the dough made.

items.description: A problem, such as flat or dense.

proof_rise_percent.description: How much more it grew in the proof, %.

room_temp_proof_hours.description: Hours of proof at room temperature.

second_bake_temp_celsius.description: Oven temperature of the second phase, °C.

starter.description: The starter it was made with.

card.description: The figures the bake card in Claude shows (ui://loafy/bake-card).

input.description: The arguments as the tool used them, after any correction.

note.description: A remark on the whole result, such as why nothing was found.

notes.description: What was corrected or left out, such as a value outside its range.

saved.description: What was saved, in one sentence.

url.description: The same answer, recipe or entry on loafy.ai.

title: Change a bake in my Loafy journal
